summary: IDF completed destruction of Hezbollah's Ali Taher tunnel network in Lebanon—8 tunnels spanning 5.4km, the largest Iranian outpost outside Iran—while Houthis seized Mayun Island and full control of Bab al-Mandab Strait. Hamas Khan Yunis brigade commander Muhammad Yazuri and a battalion commander were killed in Israeli strikes. Gulf foreign ministers will meet Iran's FM in Oman for a Strait of Hormuz shipping arrangement, the first GCC-Iran dialogue since the war began.
key_points: IDF destroyed Hezbollah's Ali Taher tunnel network—8 tunnels spanning 5.4km, the largest Iranian outpost outside Iran—containing dozens of Iranian-made rockets, missiles, drones, and hundreds of mines (Source: @manniefabian/59143).
Houthis seized Mayun Island and completed control of Bab al-Mandab Strait, a critical global shipping chokepoint (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7046).
IDF killed Muhammad Yazuri, Khan Yunis brigade commander, and a Hamas battalion commander in Khan Yunis; Yazuri directed terror operations against IDF forces and civilians (Source: @N12chat/226182).
Houthis seized full control of historic city of Mukha and reached Hanish Islands in Red Sea, threatening Bab al-Mandab Strait access (Source: @mamlekate/104432).

Gulf foreign ministers to meet Iran's FM in Oman Monday for temporary commercial shipping arrangement through Strait of Hormuz—first GCC-level gathering with senior Iranian official since war began (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7051).
Yemeni armed forces fired 3 ballistic missiles at mercenary gatherings at Ras Al-Ara; recent Yemeni bombardment smoke extended 100km+ across Saudi desert (Source: @naya_foriraq/90168).
IDF killed Novaha terrorist Ismail Ibrahim Droosh Kandal, Oct 7 participant in killing of Nahal battalion commander Lt. Col. Steinberg, in Khan Yunis earlier this week (Source: @almogboker78/18163).

sections.executive_summary: IDF completed destruction of Hezbollah's Ali Taher tunnel network in Lebanon—8 tunnels spanning 5.4km, the largest Iranian outpost outside Iran—while Houthis seized Mayun Island and full control of Bab al-Mandab Strait. Hamas Khan Yunis brigade commander Muhammad Yazuri and a battalion commander were killed in Israeli strikes. Gulf foreign ministers will meet Iran's FM in Oman for a Strait of Hormuz shipping arrangement, the first GCC-Iran dialogue since the war began.
iran: Iran financed and planned Hezbollah's tunnel infrastructure at Ali Taher over two decades; the site served as the nerve center of Hezbollah's Badr regional division responsible for southern Lebanon north of the Litani River (Source: @manniefabian/59143).

Iranian-made rockets, missiles, drones, anti-tank missiles, firearms, and hundreds of mines were found inside the Ali Taher tunnels; a central command compound with command centers, ammo rooms, and living quarters was identified (Source: @idf_telegram/25110).

IDF confirmed no Iranian IRGC members were present in the Ali Taher tunnels at time of operation, though dozens of Hezbollah operatives were killed during the offensive; some are assessed to have fled (Source: @manniefabian/59146).

Iran's FM is expected to meet Gulf foreign ministers in Oman for a temporary Strait of Hormuz shipping arrangement—the first GCC-level gathering with a senior Iranian official since the Iran war began (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7051).
israel: IDF Division 36 completed destruction of underground terror infrastructure at Ali Taher Ridge; the Chief of Staff visited the division and declared the yellow line remains under full Israeli control (Source: @idf_telegram/25118).

IDF killed Muhammad Yazuri, Khan Yunis brigade commander, and a Hamas battalion commander in Khan Yunis; Yazuri managed terrorist operations and directed attacks on IDF forces and Israeli civilians (Source: @N12chat/226182).

IDF killed Novaha terrorist Ismail Ibrahim Droosh Kandal in Khan Yunis earlier this week; he participated in the Oct 7 massacre and the killing of Nahal battalion commander Lt. Col. Yehonatan Steinberg (Source: @almogboker78/18163).
IDF will reorganize its deployment at Ali Taher but maintain control of the ridge with surveillance and firepower following tunnel destruction (Source: @manniefabian/59146).
gaza_west_bank: Muhammad Yazuri, Khan Yunis brigade commander of Hamas, was killed in an Israeli airstrike at Al-Mawasi, Khan Yunis, southern Gaza Strip; he directed terror operations against IDF and civilians (Source: @N12chat/226182).
A Hamas battalion commander and another terrorist were also killed in the same strike on Khan Yunis that eliminated brigade commander Yazuri (Source: @N12chat/226182).

Novaha terrorist Ismail Ibrahim Droosh Kandal, who participated in the Oct 7 massacre and killing of Nahal battalion commander Steinberg, was killed in Khan Yunis earlier this week (Source: @almogboker78/18163).
lebanon: Hezbollah's Ali Taher tunnel network comprised 8 tunnels spanning 5.4km total in the Ali Taher and Beaufort Castle area of southern Lebanon; two individual tunnels spanned over 2km each (Source: @manniefabian/59143).

The tunnels served as the nerve center of Hezbollah's Badr regional division, tasked with operations in southern Lebanon north of the Litani River, built over two decades with Iranian financing (Source: @manniefabian/59143).

Approximately 50 Hezbollah operatives were believed holed up under Ali Taher when the June ceasefire took effect; around a dozen bodies were found inside the tunnels by IDF troops (Source: @manniefabian/59146).

IDF troops found Hezbollah operatives opening fire from tunnel shafts; a video shows two operatives struck after firing from a shaft entrance. Some operatives assessed to have fled the area (Source: @manniefabian/59146).
syria_iraq: Yemeni armed forces targeted mercenary gatherings at Ras Al-Ara with three ballistic missiles (Source: @naya_foriraq/90168).
Smoke from recent Yemeni bombardment extended over 100km across the Saudi desert (Source: @naya_foriraq/90160).
gulf_states: Gulf foreign ministers are expected to meet Iran's foreign minister in Oman Monday to secure a temporary arrangement for commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7051).
This would be the first GCC-level gathering with a senior Iranian official since the Iran war began (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7051).
Houthis seized Mayun Island and completed control of Bab al-Mandab Strait, threatening global shipping lanes (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7046).

Houthis seized the coastal city of Mukha and reached Hanish Islands in the Red Sea, positioning to threaten Bab al-Mandab Strait; government forces retreating to Zabid directly along the strait opposite Prim Islands (Source: @mamlekate/104432).

sections.threat_assessment: The destruction of the Ali Taher tunnel network eliminates Hezbollah's central command infrastructure in southern Lebanon north of the Litani River, but IDF acknowledgment that some operatives fled and that it will maintain only surveillance and firepower on the ridge suggests residual threat persists. Houthi control of Mayun Island and Bab al-Mandab Strait represents a strategic escalation threatening global maritime commerce and potentially enabling Iranian weapons flows. The convergence of Houthi advances toward the strait and Iran-Oman diplomatic engagement indicates a dual-track Iranian strategy: military expansion through proxies combined with diplomatic efforts to ease economic pressure. Continued Israeli strikes on Hamas leadership in Khan Yunis signal ongoing operations in Gaza despite ceasefire pressures.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are pursuing direct diplomatic engagement with Iran through the Oman-mediated Strait of Hormuz shipping agreement—the first such GCC-Iran dialogue since the war began—suggesting regional urgency to secure commercial shipping lanes amid Houthi control of Bab al-Mandab. The IDF has declared the yellow line under full control and pledged immediate, forceful response to any aggression on Israeli communities, while committing to the Lebanon ceasefire. Yemeni armed forces continue ballistic missile strikes against mercenary positions at Ras Al-Ara, indicating ongoing Saudi-led coalition targeting. British authorities arrested two individuals in London for Iran-related national security violations, signaling extended Iranian operational reach beyond the immediate conflict zone.
sections.intelligence_notes: Anthropic reported that Iranian regime entities used its AI Cloud platform for government advertising, citizen surveillance, and information gathering—indicating Iran's integration of AI capabilities into domestic control and potential propaganda operations. The IDF found no IRGC personnel in the Ali Taher tunnels, suggesting Hezbollah operated this infrastructure independently despite Iranian financing and planning. Security camera documentation confirmed the seismic impact of the tunnel blasts at Ali Taher Ridge, corroborating the scale of the underground complex destruction. The Houthi rapid advance from Mukha to the Hanish Islands represents a significant strategic shift in Red Sea control that may require reassessment of maritime security postures.
